note: THE CAPTURE MANIFEST. Empty on purpose. 3D Gaussian Splatting is CAPTURED from real footage, not authored and not generated — so there is no entry here until somebody films a shake. js/shake-viewer.js renders nothing while `asset` is empty, and the storefront is unaffected. docs/spatial-commerce.md has the capture spec.

schema.slug: must match a slug in shake_products, so the capture and the thing being sold cannot drift apart
schema.asset: path to a .sog or .spz under assets/splats/. EMPTY means not captured yet, and the viewer treats it as absent.
schema.bytes: transfer size. Anything over ~8 MB needs a hard look: the customer is a student on a phone at 11pm.
schema.captured: ISO date the footage was shot
schema.views: named camera positions the commerce overlays hang off (see Section C of the blueprint)

views.note: three-quarter, the pour catching the light
close on the froth — the detail a photo cannot carry
rear of the cup; the viewpoint that opens the nutrition overlay
